scope: Static integrity checks on fictional worked output; does not test provider access, model extraction, or live Slack delivery.
checks: Fictional fixture cannot claim delivery readiness or success.
Every quoted excerpt, speaker role, start time, call ID, and source locator exactly matches its preserved fixture.
All CI decision, review, external-use, and action statuses remain at shared-contract defaults.
Only the explicit buyer-evaluation fixture is a candidate; negated and seller-only fixtures are retained with hold reasons.
Slack text preserves the buyer quote and PMM note, shows the source time, and disables source-link previews.
Deduplication keys are stable source/workspace/call/competitor identifiers and unique across these fixtures.
